# 13 — Prompt for Claude Design

**Intent:** take the 3 directions to a dedicated design tool, with the
brief's data inline (the tool cannot see the repo).
**Outcome:** a self-contained prompt, used in Claude Design. Result: the
"Day page, keyboard-driven" hybrid (see `docs/design/chosen/`).

## Prompt to Claude Code

> Can you give me a prompt to work on these 3 options using Claude design?

## Prompt used in Claude Design (generated by Claude Code)

````markdown
# Role
You are a senior product designer. Help me refine 3 visual directions for a
notes-and-reminders web app before I pick one. Explore visually; do not write
production code.

# Product in one line
A note and its reminder are ONE object. Built for Jorge, a senior developer
on 3 client projects who captures follow-ups mid-call and needs a morning
view of only what matters today.

# Attached
Three static reference sheets, one per direction:
- a-card-catalog.html — index cards on a desk. Signature: vermilion FILED
  stamp (completion only). Overdue = cards left crooked on top of today's card.
- b-ledger.html — LazyVim-style buffer, folds, statusline, which-key.
  Signature: amber NOW line (current time only).
- c-day-page.html — tear-off desk calendar, one page per day. Signature:
  green torn stub of yesterday's page (carried-over items only).

# Data (use EXACTLY this, never invent other content)
Timezone America/Mexico_City. 15 notes in total.
| ID | Title | Tag | Reminder |
|----|-------|-----|----------|
| N1 | Notify Ana: move repo permissions from me to Luis | Client A | Tue 17:00 (done at 17:00) |
| N2 | Reply to Marta about the staging deploy window | Client A | Tue 18:00 |
| N3 | Update the estimate for the onboarding epic | Client C | Tue 18:30 |
| N4 | Standup: mention the flaky checkout e2e test | Client A | Wed 09:30 |
| N5 | Send rate-limit numbers to the infra team | Client C | Wed 16:00 |
| N6 | Prep demo of search filters for the review | Client B | Thu 15:00 |
| N7–N10 | API keys rotate every 90 days · Staging URL and test accounts · Review agenda: search, exports, roles · Diego prefers async updates on Slack | Client B | — |
| N11–N15 | PR review checklist (Client A) · Domain glossary (Client C) · Shortcut cheat sheet for the team · Read: Postgres partial indexes · 1:1 with manager: topics (Personal) | — | — |

N1 body (basic markdown): Ana needs to move **admin** permissions on
`client-a/web` from me to Luis before Friday's release.
- Repo settings → Collaborators
- Keep me as *maintainer* until the handoff

# Screens to design (per direction)
1. Moment 1 · Tue 11:12 — capture in under 5 s. Before: 14 notes, 2 due
   today. After saving: 15 notes, 3 due today.
2. Moment 2 · Tue 17:00 — Web Push notification with N1's context; marked
   done in 1 click; 2 items left today (N2, N3).
3. Moment 3 · Wed 09:05 — Today view: 4 items = 2 overdue (N2, N3) + 2 due
   today (N4, N5). The other 11 notes stay out of the way.
4. Moment 4 · Thu 14:30 — filter by tag Client B: 5 notes, 1 with a
   reminder at 15:00 (N6).
5. Mobile (390 px wide): Moment 3 and Moment 1. No keyboard on a phone, so
   capture uses time presets: Today 17:00 · +1 h · Tomorrow 9:00 · Pick…
Show every screen in light AND dark mode.

# Non-negotiables
- Paper + ink + ONE accent per direction. The accent is used ONLY for that
  direction's signature concept. Overdue is never shown with red.
- Keyboard-first on desktop: main shortcuts visible on screen
  (c capture, / search, # tag filter, ? help). Monospace for times,
  tags and metadata.
- Touch targets ≥ 44 × 44 px. Visible focus states.
- Define motion for each direction plus its reduced-motion fallback.
- Snooze presets only: +1 h, Tomorrow 9:00. A snoozed item shows its
  original time ("was 09:05 · 1×").
- Must NOT look like: purple/blue gradient "AI app", glassmorphism, sparkle
  icons, a SaaS sidebar + cards + charts, Notion's option overload, Todoist's
  corporate checkbox list, or empty white + gray + one blue button.
- Should evoke: a terminal/LazyVim, an index card or pocket notebook, a desk
  calendar. Tone: calm, focused, professional — not playful, not corporate.
- Out of scope (do not design): weekly summary, recurring reminders,
  sharing, attachments, rich text, OAuth login.

# Process
1. First, critique the 3 attached sheets: for each, list the 3 strongest
   ideas and the 3 weakest points against the brief above. Stop and wait for
   my feedback.
2. Then design the screens above, one canvas per direction, with frames
   labeled "<Direction> · <Moment> · <light|dark> · <desktop|mobile>".
3. Finish with a comparison table: morning-glance clarity, capture speed,
   density, dark-mode quality, signature strength, implementation cost.
   Recommend one direction (or a hybrid) and say what you would borrow
   from the others.

Ask me at most one question at a time.
````
